newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein of Jordan to meet Oman's Sultan Qaboos.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein of Jordan to meet Oman's Sultan Qaboos.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan will fly to Oman on Saturday for talks with Sultan Qaboos on the troubled Middle East peace process, a palace official said.

The official said King Hussein would also attend celebrations in Oman for the engagement of his nephew Prince Ghazi bin Mohammad to Arej Omar Zawawi, daughter of one of Sultan Qaboos' leading advisers.
King Hussein and Sultan Qaboos, two of the Arab world's longest surviving leaders, are close personal friends and frequently exchange visits.
The king is expected to return to Jordan on Monday, the official said.
